summary: Ground L-4 cabin lookout on Bear Pete Mountain, Payette NF, Idaho: cab c.1930, destroyed 1966. No staffing history or remains described.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1966; no source describes what remains.

staffing.status: no documented staffing history (Idaho Fire Lookouts)

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags it as a hike-in site. A climbing guide says the summit is reached by trail. No source describes the cabin site today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts gives the Challis National Forest, with elevation 8751 feet. firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts and the climbing guide say Payette. The story uses Payette, the majority, and notes the disagreement.
firelookout.com says 1930+, Forest Lookouts says c.1930, Idaho Fire Lookouts says 1930. Consistent enough to date the cab to about 1930.

notes_for_editor: Agency conflict (Payette vs Challis) is not settled by any primary record. firelookout.com gives Idaho County, Idaho; the story does not state a county, so the brief's county is not changed. Elevation 8,751 vs 8,752 ft is trivial. No photo URLs captured; the 1950 University of Idaho photograph (rights: In Copyright - Educational Use Permitted) is a candidate once an image URL is found. Lookout placement on the summit is not stated by any source; the story says only that the lookout carries the same name as the mountain.
